name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2021 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques for the February 2021 US water facility SCADA incident in CISA AA21-042A. Scores: 70 the advisory describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 Inferred.

techniques.comment: Sodium hydroxide setting raised through the SCADA system (5 Feb) (basis: Behavior). Sources [92] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2021.md.
Desktop sharing software such as TeamViewer may have been used (basis: Inferred). Sources [92] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2021.md.
Manipulation of the dosing process (basis: Inferred). Sources [92] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/CHRONICLE_2021.md.

legendItems.label: 70: behavior described by the source, id assigned by the study
100: the opened source prints the ATT&CK id
